ruleset.name: Shared PMD Rules for Vaadin modules
ruleset.description: The shared PMD rules minus ConstructorCallsOverridableMethod: a Vaadin component's constructor builds the UI by calling overridable methods such as add(...), the same decision as -Xlint:-this-escape in the Vaadin parent. The reference is absolute because the pmd-ruleset execution of java/parent/pom.xml expands ${...} in both files when it copies them into target/devkit.
